description: Create a new contact. Requires `email`; optionally accepts custom `fields`, `list_ids` to subscribe to, and `unsubscribed` to start in unsubscribed status.

fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's merge tag (e.g. `first_name`). Values may be string, number, or boolean.

list_ids.description: IDs of contact lists to add this contact to.

unsubscribed.description: If true, the contact is created in `unsubscribed` status.

name: create-contact
